about.title: About us
about.intro: SUT MLC is the Machine Learning Community at Sharif University of Technology. We run reading groups, workshops, and a small weblog so students can share what they learn.

founder.name: Ermia Moghadamy
founder.bio: Started SUT MLC to give Sharif students a clear place for machine learning: sessions, writing, and a small core team that keeps the community moving.
